site.name: Coordenada Geo
site.tagline: We turn geographic data into insights
site.description: Coordenada Geo is a geographic intelligence company: we combine business intelligence and geographic data (BI+) to produce, analyse and communicate location data with technical and scientific rigour, through spatial analysis, collaborative maps and no-code interactive apps.

hero.eyebrow: For those who see beauty in geographic data
hero.title: We turn geographic data into eureka.
hero.subtitle: Geographic intelligence for companies and institutions: we produce, analyse and communicate location data with technical and scientific rigour, on a platform that puts maps, indicators and spatial analysis within reach of decision-makers, no GIS expertise required.

problem.eyebrow: BI+: business intelligence with geographic data
problem.title: Every decision happens somewhere.
problem.body: Business indicators read differently once you know where they happen. By adding the geographic dimension to business intelligence, proximity, concentration and neighbourhood become part of the analysis and explain what conventional tables and charts cannot show.
problem.quote: Everything is related to everything else, but near things are more related than distant things.
problem.quoteAuthor: Waldo Tobler, First Law of Geography (1970)

items.title: Where it happens
items.body: Locate customers, assets, incidents and opportunities on the ground and see the real distribution of your indicators.

items.title: What is nearby
items.body: Relate each point to its surroundings: competition, infrastructure, population, land use. Proximity explains patterns.

items.title: Where to act first
items.body: Prioritise areas, size markets and allocate resources based on spatial evidence.

problem.closing: That is what we call BI+ (BI plus): business intelligence plus the missing dimension, place.

solutions.title: Solutions for every stage, from data to decision
solutions.intro: From producing the data to communicating the results, you choose where to start and expand as your organisation's needs grow.

items.title: Geographic data production and structuring
items.body: Technical support to survey, organise, standardise and qualify geographic datasets, with a defined methodology and quality control.

items.title: Location intelligence and spatial analysis
items.body: Cross your data with other datasets, identify patterns and areas of opportunity, and answer where to operate, invest or intervene first.

items.title: No-code geographic data apps
items.body: Turn a geographic file into an interactive app with maps, charts and tables, with the option to process everything in the browser.

items.title: Collaborative web maps
items.body: Create, organise and share maps with teams, clients and partners, so everyone works from the same information.

items.title: Enterprise geospatial platform
items.body: A dedicated environment for your organisation to bring geographic data together, manage access permissions and integrate with your systems via API.

about.title: Over twenty years of geoprocessing, now as a platform.
about.body: The Coordenada Geo team brings over twenty years of experience in geoprocessing and in developing modelling and analysis technologies for geographic information systems. We bring that knowledge to a platform and services that deliver the rigour of geospatial analysis to companies, institutions and analysts, with clear communication for non-specialists.
bullets: Over 20 years of experience in geoprocessing and geographic information systems.
Development of technologies for geospatial modelling and analysis.
Technical and scientific rigour at every stage: from producing the data to analysing and communicating the results.

purpose.title: Shortening the path from data to decision
purpose.body: Geographic data holds answers about health, production, the environment, security and the economy, but those answers only make an impact when someone can see them. Our purpose is to make that moment of discovery easier: to make it simpler to extract, understand and consume the information data holds, so every insight reaches further and informs more decisions.

items.title: Precision
items.body: Technical and scientific rigour in methods and in how data is represented, so every map, chart and table shows what the data really says.

items.title: Collaboration
items.body: We build the product together with the people who use it, listening to analysts, companies and users to evolve the platform where it matters.

items.title: Adaptation
items.body: A flexible platform that adapts to different data types, sectors and analysis needs, and keeps evolving.

items.title: Revitalisation
items.body: We prioritise uses with a positive impact on people, ecosystems and territories.

platform.title: From data to decision, in three stages.
platform.body: Whether it's your company's database, a geographic file or data that still needs to be produced, the method is the same: structure, analyse and communicate, with rigour at every stage.

steps.title: Data
steps.body: We start from your databases, files and spreadsheets, or support producing the data you need.

steps.title: Information
steps.body: Exploration, cross-referencing and spatial analysis turn records into indicators and patterns.

steps.title: Decision
steps.body: Results reach decision-makers as maps, dashboards and interactive apps, shared with whoever you choose.

services.title: What changes when analysis accounts for place
services.intro: Less time preparing data, more time understanding and deciding.

items.title: Better-grounded decisions
items.body: Spatial analysis and clear indicators show where risks and opportunities lie, based on evidence.

items.title: Patterns spreadsheets don't reveal
items.body: Concentrations, trends and neighbourhood relationships emerge when data gains a map and context.

items.title: A shared view
items.body: Teams, clients and partners access the same information in the browser, without emailing files around.

items.title: Clear communication for decision-makers
items.body: Maps, dashboards and interactive apps translate technical analysis into a direct reading the audience can explore on its own.

items.title: Data privacy and control
items.body: You decide where your data lives: in your organisation's isolated environment or, when you prefer, processed right in your browser without leaving your machine. Nothing is shared without your authorisation.

items.title: Accessible to non-specialists
items.body: Analysts don't need to code. Viewers don't need to install GIS software.

useCases.title: For organisations that make decisions about places

items.title: Analysts and geo professionals
items.body: Faster analysis and results delivered as maps and interactive apps that showcase the technical work.

items.title: Companies, sales and expansion teams
items.body: Understand where your customers, your locations and the best market opportunities are, with the whole team working from the same base.

items.title: Agriculture and the environment
items.body: Properties, protected areas, vegetation cover and deforestation: analyse the territory and present results to producers, agencies, funders and communities.

items.title: Public sector, health, security and economy
items.body: Cases, incidents, facilities and regional indicators: an interactive map communicates in seconds what a table takes pages to explain, and helps prioritise where to act.

items.a: It is business intelligence plus the geographic component: the "plus" is GIS. Beyond answering how much and when, the analysis also answers where, and takes into account proximity and neighbourhood relationships between customers, locations, incidents and the surrounding territory.

items.q: My data isn't organised yet. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. We support surveying, organising and qualifying geographic datasets, so the analysis starts from consistent data.

You choose. Data can stay in your organisation's environment, isolated and access-controlled, or, in solutions such as apps created from files, be processed only in your browser, without leaving your machine. Nothing is shared without your authorisation.

items.q: Do I need to know GIS or how to code?
items.a: No. The platform is designed for people who need answers, not tools to configure. Anyone viewing the result only needs a browser.

items.q: Does the platform replace my GIS?
items.a: Not necessarily. It complements tools such as QGIS and ArcGIS: your team keeps using what it already knows and relies on Coordenada Geo to analyse, integrate and communicate more easily.
The formats most used in geoprocessing, plus spreadsheets with coordinates. The full list will be published at launch, and you can tell us which formats you need.

items.q: Does it work for any sector?
items.a: Yes. Agriculture and the environment have a strong tradition with geographic data, but the same applies to retail, commercial expansion, health, security, logistics and the public sector: wherever there is territory, there is something to discover.
The platform is in beta. Terms for each solution will be announced at launch, and beta participants talk directly with the team and help shape the product.
